<div class="loop">

<div class="step">Experiment</div><div class="arr">→</div>
<div class="step">Paper</div><div class="arr">→</div>
<div class="step">Submit</div><div class="arr">→</div>

## What This Tells Us {#insights}

- **LLM & medical imaging** are both what people want and what we already do
- **Earth observation, efficient LLMs, industrial AI** are new for us, and outside collaborators would need to lead them
- **15 people** have no idea yet, so they could start on a learning / analyst track

<span class="tag disc">DISCUSSION</span> Which 2–3 clusters do we commit to?
